description: This file defines a class 'BuiltIn' that maps built-in color indexes to their corresponding RGB hex color codes for use within the PhpSpreadsheet library's XLS reader module.

classes.name: BuiltIn
classes.description: Provides a mapping from built-in color indexes to their RGB hex color codes.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Returns the RGB hex color code associated with a given built-in color index.
